description: This file contains test cases and utility functions for loading and testing Vertex AI credentials and async call performance in a Python testing suite using pytest and asyncio. It includes credential setup, performance benchmarking, and asynchronous request handling.

methods.name: load_vertex_ai_credentials()
methods.description: Loads and updates Google Cloud Vertex AI credentials from a file and environment variables, then sets the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable.

methods.name: test_vertex_load()
methods.description: Asynchronous pytest test that measures the performance of Vertex AI calls with different message types and verifies that performance differences stay within a threshold.

methods.name: make_async_calls(message_type="text")
methods.description: Performs multiple asynchronous calls to a specified endpoint to simulate load and measure total elapsed time.

methods.name: create_async_task(message_type)
methods.description: Creates an asyncio task that invokes the litellm.acompletion method with specified message content depending on the message type.
